prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished 16:9 PC pixel-art game UI reference screenshot, Korean vending-machine clicker. Combine the ability collection window and drink-unlock window into ONE coherent interface. Reference image 1 is approved vending machine and all 15 drink designs; reference 2 is the exact Japanese alley backdrop. Darken backdrop 53%, blue metal pixel borders, cream panels, navy rows, gold/cyan accents, chunky readable Korean Cafe24 PRO UP style type. High fidelity finished game screenshot, no browser chrome. Status labels must distinguish unlocked '해금 완료' from locked '미해금'. Empty cans unlock drink eligibility, NOT upgrading ability directly; abilities grow from drawing drinks during play. No buy upgrade buttons. Only locked selected drink has explicit button '빈캔 5개로 추가'; button unlocks draw pool, not immediate drink acquisition. Show '보유 빈캔 18' and small disclaimer '수치는 시안 예시'. Selected unlocked water example '획득 3개', '1개당 발견 골드 +1', '현재 누적 +3 Gold'. Locked ion example '이온음료', '상위 골드 발견 확률 증가', '해금 후 자판기에서 등장'. Other drink texts use short names/status only to prevent misinformation. All 15 approved drinks include water green tea barley ion apple ginger lemonade lime peach orange vitamin melon golden cola energy, matching reference artwork. Do not depict old branching skill tree. Title '음료와 능력', close X and ESC. Concept A: unified machine + inspector. Large attractive red vending cabinet left-center, all 15 drinks arranged 3 rows by 5 in slots, locked drinks dimmed with tiny locks, water selected cyan outline. Right side tall cream detail panel with large water sprite, name, acquired count, per-item effect and cumulative effect. Directly below detail show a clearly separated small preview for locked ion with lock and can-cost unlock button. Full width bottom navy summary bar '현재 적용된 능력' with search, gold bonus, blank chance illustrated icons. No tabs; direct click on cabinet changes selected drink detail. Preserve space, strong typography, balanced proportions, show cabinet as the main selector and stats as secondary.
